original_value: The Best for Your Compact BuildASUS Phoenix GeForce® GTX 1050 Ti comes equipped with a dual ball-bearing fan for a 2X longer card lifespan and exclusive Auto-Extreme Technology with Super Alloy Power II components for superior stability. ASUS Phoenix GeForce® GTX 1050 Ti also has GPU Tweak II with XSplit Gamecaster that provides intuitive performance tweaking and real-time streaming. It provides best experience in games such as Overwatch, Dota 2, CS Go and League of Legend.

result.paraphrase: ASUS Phoenix GeForce® GTX 1050 Ti is ideal for a compact build, featuring a dual ball-bearing fan that doubles the card’s lifespan, plus exclusive Auto-Extreme Technology and Super Alloy Power II components for improved stability. It also includes GPU Tweak II with XSplit Gamecaster for easy performance tuning and real-time streaming. Delivers an excellent gaming experience in titles like Overwatch, Dota 2, CS Go, and League of Legend.
